import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static final int T = 99;
    static final int C = 15;
    static final int N = 50 * T + 2;          // max number of nodes = 4952
    static final int M = 2 * N * C + N + 7;   // max directional edges = 153519
    static final long INF = Long.MAX_VALUE / 2;

    static class Flow {
        static int[] first = new int[N];
        static int[] nxt = new int[2 * M];
        static int[] ep = new int[2 * M];
        static long[] cap = new long[2 * M];
        static long[] flo = new long[2 * M];
        static long[] cost = new long[2 * M];
        static int m = 0;
        static int[] par = new int[N];
        static long[] pot = new long[N];
        static long[] dist = new long[N];
        static boolean[] vis = new boolean[N];

        static void init() {
            m = 0;
            Arrays.fill(first, -1);
            Arrays.fill(flo, 0);
        }

        static void add_edge(int a, int b, long c, long p) {
            // forward edge
            nxt[m] = first[a];
            first[a] = m;
            ep[m] = a;
            cap[m] = c;
            cost[m] = p;
            flo[m] = 0;
            m++;
            // reverse edge
            nxt[m] = first[b];
            first[b] = m;
            ep[m] = b;
            cap[m] = 0;
            cost[m] = -p;
            flo[m] = 0;
            m++;
        }

        static void mcf_pot_init(int n) {
            Arrays.fill(pot, 0);
            // Bellman-Ford to set initial potentials (all costs are non‑negative, so this is just for safety)
            for (int k = 1; k < n; ++k) {
                for (int e = 0; e < m; ++e) {
                    if (cap[e] > 0) {
                        int u = ep[e];
                        int v = ep[e ^ 1];
                        if (pot[u] + cost[e] < pot[v]) {
                            pot[v] = pot[u] + cost[e];
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        static long mcf_update(int s, int t, long[] price, int n) {
            Arrays.fill(vis, false);
            Arrays.fill(dist, INF);
            dist[s] = 0;
            PriorityQueue<long[]> pq = new PriorityQueue<>((a, b) -> Long.compare(a[0], b[0]));
            pq.offer(new long[]{0, s});

            while (!pq.isEmpty()) {
                long[] cur = pq.poll();
                long d = cur[0];
                int u = (int) cur[1];
                if (vis[u]) continue;
                vis[u] = true;
                for (int e = first[u]; e != -1; e = nxt[e]) {
                    int v = ep[e ^ 1];
                    if (flo[e] < cap[e]) {
                        long nd = d + pot[u] - pot[v] + cost[e];
                        if (nd < dist[v]) {
                            dist[v] = nd;
                            par[v] = e;
                            pq.offer(new long[]{nd, v});
                        }
                    }
                }
            }

            if (dist[t] >= INF) return 0;

            long df = INF;
            for (int e, i = t; i != s; i = ep[e]) {
                e = par[i];
                df = Math.min(df, cap[e] - flo[e]);
            }
            for (int e, i = t; i != s; i = ep[e]) {
                e = par[i];
                flo[e] += df;
                flo[e ^ 1] -= df;
                price[0] += df * cost[e];
            }
            for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
                if (dist[i] < INF) {
                    pot[i] = Math.min(INF, dist[i] + pot[i]);
                }
            }
            return df;
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        int n = sc.nextInt();
        int m = sc.nextInt();
        int k = sc.nextInt();
        int c = sc.nextInt();
        int d = sc.nextInt();

        int source = 0;
        int sink = n * T + 1;
        int nodeCount = n * T + 2;

        Flow.init();

        for (int i = 0; i < k; i++) {
            int a = sc.nextInt();
            Flow.add_edge(source, a, 1, 0);
        }

        for (int t = 0; t < T; t++) {
            Flow.add_edge(1 + t * n, sink, INF, 0);
            if (t > 0) {
                for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
                    Flow.add_edge(i + (t - 1) * n, i + t * n, INF, c);
                }
            }
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
            int a = sc.nextInt();
            int b = sc.nextInt();
            for (int j = 0; j < C; j++) {
                long cost = (j + 1) * (j + 1) - j * j;   // = 2*j+1
                for (int t = 1; t < T; t++) {
                    Flow.add_edge(a + (t - 1) * n, b + t * n, 1, cost * d + c);
                    Flow.add_edge(b + (t - 1) * n, a + t * n, 1, cost * d + c);
                }
            }
        }

        Flow.mcf_pot_init(nodeCount);
        long[] priceRef = new long[]{0};
        long flow = 0;
        while (true) {
            long df = Flow.mcf_update(source, sink, priceRef, nodeCount);
            if (df == 0) break;
            flow += df;
        }
        // assert flow == k;
        System.out.println(priceRef[0]);
    }
}
